mainEntity.name: Do I need permits for new window installation in Orange County?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes, for most new window installations in Orange County, a building permit is typically required, especially if structural changes are involved or if you are modifying the size or type of the opening. This ensures compliance with local building codes and safety standards. We manage the permitting process for you, streamlining the project from start to finish.
